name: Problem-then-promise headline
looks: On a near-black ground, a dim one-line question fades up first, then a bold answer line lands beneath it in full brightness, the contrast between the two weights doing the work of a problem-then-solution pitch in under two seconds.
build: Question line fades in at reduced opacity/weight (`opacity 0 -> 0.5`, ~200ms); the answer line arrives a beat later at full opacity and a heavier weight (`y:8px -> 0`, power2.out, ~300ms), clearly the dominant element in the frame.
sound: A soft low swell under the question, a brighter hit as the bold answer lands.
prompt: Open on a dim, quiet question fading up, then land a bold, full-brightness answer beneath it a beat later, letting the contrast in weight between the two lines carry the problem-then-solution pitch on its own.
